title: My Bedroom
description: Three short recordings about bedrooms: a small room, a messy room and bedtime.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · My room
parts.intro: You will hear a girl called Mai.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: This is my bedroom. It is small but nice.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I have a pink bed and a yellow lamp.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: My toys are in a box under the bed. My teddy bear is on the pillow.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I love my room.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: My bedroom window is big. I can see the garden and the trees.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: At night, I look at the moon from my bed. It is lovely.

parts.title: Part 2 · A messy room
parts.intro: You will hear Lily and her dad.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Lily, your room is messy.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: Sorry, Dad.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Put your books on the shelf.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: OK. Where do my clothes go?

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: In the wardrobe, not on the floor.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: And the ball?

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: In the toy box.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: Now my room is tidy, Dad. Look at it!

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Well done, Lily. It looks so nice. Thank you for your help.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: I will keep it clean. I promise.

parts.title: Part 3 · Bedtime
parts.intro: You will hear Ben and his mum.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Ben, it's time for bed.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Can I read a book?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Yes, one book. Then lights off.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Can I have my night light?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Yes. Good night, Ben.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Sleep well, my boy. See you in the morning.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Good night, Mum. I love you.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: I love you too, Ben. Sweet dreams.
